text: Effective time management really matters in today's fast-paced work environment. People who build good organizational habits are better at meeting deadlines and they feel less stressed. A few strategies can help you be more productive. First, prioritize. Work out which tasks matter most and do those first, so the critical stuff gets done. Second, cut down on distractions. Blocking out time for focused work is widely seen as helpful. Finally, take regular breaks to keep your performance up.
